peer_review.findings: No duplicate DOI/title conflict. Three existing bylines preserve eleven Person IDs. Six blank bylines need fifteen Work-scoped Person records; no same-DOI orphan Person found. Global homonym merging is not supported.
peer_review.counting: Covered the same nine Work identity items; not counted again.

shared_source_query_check.conclusion: A single successful DOI-filter batch returned both citing Works. Their version/ordinal/reference keys and occurrence IDs differ; both occurrences and both edge pairs must be retained.

reference_matching_policy: Match candidate_ids or the DOI field/actual unstructured citation text. Do not match a citing DOI embedded in Crossref reference.key, source.identifier or source URL. Match existing edges by citing_key/cited_key, not only by Work IDs.
query_audit_qualification: Failed source-access receipts remain failures and their unknown counts remain unknown. Indexed search receipts have visible search-hit counts but unknown source total and pagination; query-audit completion remains partial independently of target identity-task closure.
